questions.question_hindi:

I. आत्म-प्राप्ति की आवश्यकताएँ
II. सुरक्षा की आवश्यकताएँ
III. शारीरिक आवश्यकताएँ
IV. सम्मान की आवश्यकताएँ
V. सामाजिक आवश्यकताएँ
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा विकल्प सबसे निचले से सबसे ऊँचे स्तर तक सही क्रम का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?
options_hindi: III, II, V, IV, I
III, V, II, IV, I
II, III, V, I, IV
III, II, IV, V, I

questions.question_english:
Consider the following needs according to Abraham Maslow’s Hierarchy of Needs:
I. Self-actualization needs
II. Safety needs
III. Physiological needs
IV. Esteem needs
V. Social needs
Which of the following options represents the correct ascending order from the lowest to the highest level?
options_english: III, II, V, IV, I
III, V, II, IV, I
II, III, V, I, IV
III, II, IV, V, I
questions.explanation_english: Maslow’s Hierarchy of Needs structures human motivation into five ascending levels, starting from basic deficiency needs up to growth needs. The progression begins at the base with physiological needs, followed sequentially by safety needs, social needs, esteem needs, and culminates at the apex with self-actualization needs.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। मास्लो की आवश्यकताओं की श्रेणी मानव प्रेरणा को पांच चढ़ते स्तरों में संरचित करती है, जो मूल कमी की आवश्यकताओं से लेकर विकास की आवश्यकताओं तक होती है। यह प्रगति शारीरिक आवश्यकताओं से शुरू होती है, इसके बाद सुरक्षा की आवश्यकताएँ, सामाजिक आवश्यकताएँ, सम्मान की आवश्यकताएँ, और अंततः आत्म-प्राप्ति की आवश्यकताएँ आती हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) III, II, V, IV, I

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Maslow’s Hierarchy of Needs structures human motivation into five ascending levels, starting from basic deficiency needs up to growth needs.

questions.question_hindi:
एक प्रधान दो अलग-अलग शिक्षकों को नोटिस करता है: शिक्षक

    यदि बाधित किया जाए तो निराश हो जाता है। शिक्षक बी अपने फ्री पीरियड्स में स्टाफ रूम में सामाजिक
    समारोहों का आयोजन करता है और सहयोगियों की भलाई की जांच करता है। मैकक्लेलैंड के अनुसार:
options_hindi: शिक्षक ए nAff में उच्च है; शिक्षक बी nPow में उच्च है।
शिक्षक ए nPow में उच्च है; शिक्षक बी nAch में उच्च है।
दोनों शिक्षक मुख्य रूप से nPow द्वारा प्रेरित हैं।
शिक्षक ए nAch में उच्च है; शिक्षक बी nAff में उच्च है।
questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Motivation Theories and Managerial Application
questions.subject: Management
questions.question_english:
A Principal observes two distinct teachers: Teacher
    A works late to refine their lesson plans and
    becomes frustrated if interrupted. Teacher B utilizes
    free periods in the staff room to organize social
    gatherings and check on colleagues’ well-being. According to McClelland:
options_english: Teacher A is high in nAff; Teacher B is high in nPow.
Teacher A is high in nPow; Teacher B is high in nAch.
Both teachers are primarily driven by nPow.
Teacher A is high in nAch; Teacher B is high in nAff.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is that Teacher A is high in nAch and Teacher B is high in nAff. Teacher A's behavior of perfecting lesson plans independently and seeking feedback illustrates a high achievement drive (nAch). In contrast, Teacher B's focus on organizing social gatherings and prioritizing peer well-being demonstrates a high affiliation drive (nAff). These distinct workplace behaviors exemplify how McClelland’s acquired needs influence individual priorities and professional interactions.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। शिक्षक ए nAch में उच्च है; शिक्षक बी nAff में उच्च है। पाठ योजनाओं को परिपूर्ण करने और कार्य फीडबैक की खोज करना उच्च उपलब्धि प्रेरणा (nAch) को दर्शाता है। सामाजिक समारोहों का आयोजन और सहयोगियों की भलाई को प्राथमिकता देना उच्च संबंध प्रेरणा (nAff) को दर्शाता है। ये भिन्न कार्यस्थल व्यवहार यह दर्शाते हैं कि मैकक्लेलैंड की अधिग्रहित आवश्यकताएँ व्यक्तिगत प्राथमिकताओं और पेशेवर इंटरैक्शन को कैसे आकार देती हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Teacher A is high in nAch; Teacher B is high in nAff.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Perfecting lesson plans independently and seeking task feedback illustrates high achievement drive (nAch). Organizing social gatherings and prioritizing peer well-being demonstrates a high affiliation drive (nAff).

questions.question_hindi: एक अत्यधिक सक्षम शिक्षक जानता है कि वह आसानी से अपने विषय में 100% पास परिणाम प्राप्त कर सकता है (उच्च अपेक्षा)। शिक्षक 'सर्वश्रेष्ठ शिक्षक पुरस्कार' को भी गहराई से महत्व देता है (उच्च वैलेंस)। हालाँकि, शिक्षक अतिरिक्त प्रयास करने से इनकार करता है क्योंकि वह मानता है कि प्रधानाध्यापक पक्षपाती हैं और केवल अपने पसंदीदा को पुरस्कार देते हैं, चाहे वास्तविक परिणाम कुछ भी हों। इस परिदृश्य में, क्या कमी है?
options_hindi: इंस्ट्रुमेंटैलिटी
अपेक्षा
वैलेंस
क्षमता

questions.question_english: A highly capable teacher is aware that they can easily achieve a 100% pass rate in their subject (High Expectancy). The teacher also places significant value on the 'Best Teacher Award' (High Valence). However, the teacher refrains from exerting extra effort due to the belief that the Principal is biased and awards only their favorites, irrespective of actual outcomes. In this scenario, what is lacking?
options_english: Instrumentality
Expectancy
Valence
Ability
questions.explanation_english: High Expectancy and high Valence are present when an employee believes that effort leads to success and strongly desires the reward. However, the perception that reward distribution is biased undermines the perceived link between performance and reward, resulting in low Instrumentality, which ultimately diminishes overall motivation.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। उच्च अपेक्षा और उच्च वैलेंस तब होते हैं जब एक कर्मचारी मानता है कि प्रयास सफलता लाता है और पुरस्कार की गहरी इच्छा रखता है। हालाँकि, पुरस्कार आवंटन में पक्षपात का विश्वास प्रदर्शन और पुरस्कार के बीच के संबंध को तोड़ देता है, जिससे इंस्ट्रुमेंटैलिटी कम होती है, जो अंततः समग्र प्रेरणा को नष्ट कर देती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Instrumentality
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: High Expectancy and high Valence are present when an employee believes that effort leads to success and strongly desires the reward.

questions.question_english: Edwin Locke’s Goal-Setting Theory emphasizes that setting goals is a primary source of motivation. According to this theory, to be maximally effective, goals should be:
options_english: Vague and general, like 'do your best'
Easy and universally achievable by all staff
Specific and challenging, yet attainable
Kept secret by the management until the end of the year
questions.explanation_english: Edwin Locke’s Goal-Setting Theory posits that performance is optimized when goals are clear, specific, and challenging yet achievable. Specific goals direct cognitive effort, while challenging goals enhance performance more effectively than vague instructions or easy targets, provided that individuals have the requisite skills and commitment to the goals.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। एडविन लॉक का लक्ष्य-निर्धारण सिद्धांत यह दर्शाता है कि प्रदर्शन तब अधिकतम होता है जब लक्ष्य स्पष्ट, विशिष्ट और चुनौतीपूर्ण होते हैं, फिर भी प्राप्त करने योग्य होते हैं। विशिष्ट लक्ष्य संज्ञानात्मक प्रयास को केंद्रित करते हैं, जबकि चुनौतीपूर्ण लक्ष्य प्रदर्शन को बेहतर तरीके से उत्तेजित करते हैं, बशर्ते कि व्यक्तियों के पास आवश्यक कौशल और लक्ष्य के प्रति प्रतिबद्धता हो।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Specific and challenging, yet attainable

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Edwin Locke’s Goal-Setting Theory demonstrates that performance is maximized when goals are clear, specific, and challenging yet achievable.

questions.question_english:
The ‘Overjustification Effect’ occurs when an
expected external incentive decreases a person’s
intrinsic motivation to perform a task. Which of
the following actions by a Principal is most likely
to cause this effect?
options_english: Consistently offering public verbal praise to a teacher who demonstrates exceptional classroom management and student discipline.
Introducing fixed financial rewards for every voluntary remedial lesson taken by a previously passionate teacher.
Granting complete professional autonomy to a teacher in selecting specialized literature texts for an extracurricular reading club.
Sponsoring a senior teacher to attend a comprehensive advanced capacity-building workshop within their specific subject area.
questions.explanation_english:
The overjustification effect occurs when external
tangible rewards are introduced for activities
that individuals previously performed out of
pure intrinsic interest. Providing financial
compensation for intrinsically rewarding
voluntary actions shifts cognitive focus to
external rewards, diminishing internal passion,
self-determination, and personal fulfillment
associated with the educational activity.

questions.question_english:
The classic example of a 'starving artist' or an
'underpaid but deeply passionate teacher' best illustrates which criticism of Maslow's hierarchy?
options_english: Human psychological drives are far too complex to be categorized into five neat, sequential hierarchical levels.
External material incentives and financial rewards invariably exert a stronger influence on human action than internal drives.
Interpersonal social connections and peer belongingness exert no meaningful influence within professional employment contexts.
Higher-order needs can motivate human action even when basic deficiency needs remain severely unfulfilled.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (d) Higher-order needs can motivate human action even when basic deficiency needs remain severely unfulfilled. This option highlights that individuals may pursue artistic or educational passions despite lacking basic necessities, demonstrating that higher-order needs can drive behavior independently of lower-order needs. In contrast, option (a) suggests an overly complex view of psychological drives, which does not directly address the criticism of Maslow's hierarchy. Option (b) emphasizes external rewards, which contradicts the essence of higher-order motivations. Option (c) incorrectly asserts that social connections have no impact, which is not true in many professional contexts.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। उच्च-क्रम की आवश्यकताएँ मानव क्रिया को प्रेरित कर सकती हैं हालाँकि मूल कमी की आवश्यकताएँ गंभीर रूप से असंतुष्ट रह सकती हैं। यह विकल्प यह दर्शाता है कि व्यक्ति मूलभूत आवश्यकताओं की कमी के बावजूद कलात्मक या शैक्षणिक जुनून का पीछा कर सकते हैं, यह दिखाते हुए कि उच्च-क्रम की आवश्यकताएँ निम्न-क्रम की आवश्यकताओं से स्वतंत्र रूप से व्यवहार को प्रेरित कर सकती हैं। इसके विपरीत, विकल्प (a) मनोवैज्ञानिक प्रेरणाओं के अत्यधिक जटिल दृष्टिकोण का सुझाव देता है, जो मास्लो के पदानुक्रम की आलोचना को सीधे संबोधित नहीं करता। विकल्प (b) बाहरी पुरस्कारों पर जोर देता है, जो उच्च-क्रम की प्रेरणाओं के सार के विपरीत है। विकल्प (c) गलत तरीके से यह बताता है कि सामाजिक संबंधों का कोई प्रभाव नहीं है, जो कई पेशेवर संदर्भों में सच नहीं है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Higher-order needs can motivate human action even when basic deficiency needs remain severely unfulfilled.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Instances where individuals display intense devotion to creative, artistic, or educational pursuits despite experiencing poverty or lack of safety highlight that higher-order growth needs can serve as primary motivators independently of lower-order deficiency satisfaction, directly challenging Maslow’s strict hierarchical order.

questions.question_english: In public school administration, where a Principal has limited authority to modify basic salary scales or provide cash bonuses, which motivational strategy becomes the most essential tool for the Head of School?
options_english: Frequently threatening underperforming staff with formal administrative suspension proceedings under state educational regulations.

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is cultivating a positive school climate, offering recognition, and providing growth opportunities. When financial compensation is constrained by rigid public regulations, administrators must rely on non-monetary motivators. Creating a supportive environment, acknowledging professional contributions, providing pedagogical autonomy, and offering meaningful professional development opportunities are effective strategies to enhance staff engagement and intrinsic motivation.

questions.question_english: From an empirical perspective, researchers have found it challenging to validate Maslow's concept of 'need deprivation' because:

Reason (R): Transformational leaders inspire followers by communicating a compelling vision and elevating their higher-order needs, whereas transactional leaders rely on contingent external rewards and punishments.

questions.explanation_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A. Transformational leaders motivate followers intrinsically by projecting an inspiring shared vision, promoting intellectual stimulation, and supporting higher-order growth needs. Conversely, transactional leaders rely primarily on extrinsic mechanisms, exchanging contingent rewards or applying corrective interventions based on contractual compliance.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। परिवर्तनकारी नेता अनुयायियों को अंतर्निहित रूप से प्रेरित करते हैं एक प्रेरक साझा दृष्टि को प्रस्तुत करके, बौद्धिक उत्तेजना को बढ़ावा देकर, और उच्च-क्रम की विकास आवश्यकताओं का समर्थन करके। इसके विपरीत, लेन-देनात्मक नेता मुख्य रूप से बाह्य तंत्रों पर निर्भर करते हैं, सशर्त पुरस्कारों का आदान-प्रदान करते हैं या संविदात्मक अनुपालन के आधार पर सुधारात्मक हस्तक्षेप लागू करते हैं।
